description: This file contains the PHP class 'Basic' which is part of the admin extension for OpenCart's CAPTCHA authentication system. It provides functionalities for displaying and saving CAPTCHA configurations within the OpenCart admin interface.

classes.name: Basic
classes.description: A controller class for the CAPTCHA basic extension in the OpenCart admin panel, handling display and saving of CAPTCHA settings.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Loads the CAPTCHA configuration page, setting up breadcrumbs, page title, and including header, footer, and content views.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes the saving of CAPTCHA configuration settings, including permission checks and returning JSON response.
